governs: Forbids treating empty cartridge cases, primers, bullets or powder as outside the rules governing ammunition
operative_text: The term "ammunition" means ammunition or cartridge cases, primers, bullets, or propellent powder designed for use in any firearm.
reasoning: DECISIVE for the marketplace question and for brass. The intuitive reading that brass and bullets are inert components outside the law is wrong at the statutory level: brass is ammunition not yet assembled. A reloader trading empty brass across state lines is dealing in ammunition under the GCA. This row is why Phase 9 brass is marked CONTESTED rather than permitted.

governs: Forbids engaging in the business of dealing in ammunition without a licence
operative_text: except a licensed importer , licensed manufacturer , or licensed dealer, to engage in the business of importing, manufacturing, or dealing in firearms, or in the course of such business to ship, transport, or receive any firearm in interstate or foreign commerce ; or (B) except a licensed importer or licensed manufacturer , to engage in the business of importing or manufacturing ammunition
reasoning: The word business is doing the work. A one-off disposal of surplus is not obviously a business; a marketplace on which we facilitate regular transactions is much closer to one. This is why the recommendation is about the venue we provide, not only about what is listed.

short_name: Interstate shipment to an unlicensed person
governs: Forbids shipping ammunition in interstate or foreign commerce to anyone not a licensed dealer or manufacturer
operative_text: It shall be unlawful— (1) for any person— (A) except a licensed importer , licensed manufacturer , or licensed dealer, to engage in the business of importing, manufacturing, or dealing in firearms
reasoning: Pairs with 921(a)(17)(A). Because brass and bullets are ammunition, mailing them across state lines is what this addresses - the federal exposure sits with the individual shipping, and a platform that facilitates it does not sit outside it.

short_name: A frame or receiver is a firearm
governs: Forbids listing or transferring any firearm frame or receiver, including unfinished ones
operative_text: any weapon (including a starter gun) which will or is designed to or may readily be converted to expel a projectile by the action of an explosive; (B) the frame or receiver of any such weapon
reasoning: The consequence nobody expects. An 80 percent lower or receiver is a firearm whether finished or not. Used reloading equipment is the category most likely to sweep one in casually, and a marketplace operator cannot know what is in the box before the transaction completes.

governs: Forbids any combination of parts designed to convert a device into a destructive device
operative_text: (C) any combination of parts either designed or intended for use in converting any device into any destructive device described in subparagraph (A) or (B) and from which a destructive device may be readily assembled.
reasoning: Recorded because it is the nearest neighbours definition to the excluded categories. It is why we do not reason loosely about what a component becomes in combination.

governs: Forbids writing or creating a review that misrepresents the reviewer, their use, or their experience
operative_text: It is an unfair or deceptive act or practice and a violation of this part for a business to write, create, or sell a consumer review , consumer testimonial , or celebrity testimonial that materially misrepresents, expressly or by implication: (1) That the reviewer or testimonialist exists; (2) That the reviewer or testimonialist used or otherwise had experience with the product, service, or business that is the subject of the review or testimonial; or (3) The reviewer's or testimonialist's experience with the product, service, or business that is the subject of the review or testimonial.
reasoning: This is what the ratings we removed on 2 Oct 2026 were: no reviewer existed, so clauses (1) and (2) were both violated. The removal was correct and is not reversible.

short_name: Purchasing or disseminating a false review
governs: Forbids purchasing a review, or disseminating one we knew or should have known was false
operative_text: It is an unfair or deceptive act or practice and a violation of this part for a business to purchase a consumer review , or to disseminate or cause the dissemination of a consumer testimonial or celebrity testimonial , about the business or one of the products or services it sells, which the business knew or should have known materially misrepresented
reasoning: Two consequences. We may not pay for reviews, which is why creator partnerships may cover promotion but never a finding. And knowingly hosting a fake review is prohibited, which is why the monitoring procedure is not optional.

governs: Permits displaying genuine third-party reviews that we did not write
operative_text: Reviews that appear on a website or platform as a result of the business merely engaging in consumer review hosting
reasoning: The provision that makes the whole review programme lawful. Aggregating genuine third-party reviews is expressly contemplated; fabricating, buying or ignoring them is not. This is the line between hosting and authoring.

governs: Forbids filtering out a seller's service, delivery, returns or exchange complaints
operative_text: But be aware that suppressing customer reviews about a "particular seller's customer service, delivery, returns, and exchanges" can be deceptive in violation of Section 5 of the FTC Act.
reasoning: Quoted verbatim because the trap is counter-intuitive: an even-handed filter that removes service complaints is still deceptive. A retailer rating that quietly drops slow-shipping complaints is a deceptive rating, however neutral the rule looks.

short_name: Fake indicators of social media influence
governs: Forbids purchasing fake followers or engagement
operative_text: The provision is limited to the purchase of fake indicators of social media influence which you knew or should have known were fake.
reasoning: Recorded because any future social account for the project inherits this. The limit is on knowingly buying the fake indicator, not on benefiting from one innocently - which means a red flag we should have noticed is what creates liability.

short_name: SAAMI standards intended for commercial manufacturers
governs: Forbids publishing SAAMI dimensional or performance data as though we were a commercial manufacturer entitled to it
operative_text: The information contained in the SAAMI standards is intended for use by commercial ammunition and firearm manufacturers only. While the dimensional and performance characteristics apply equally to factory-manufactured and reloaded/hand loaded ammunition, SAAMI cannot provide any guidance on propellant selection, charge weights, primer selection or other hand loading/reloading-specific questions.
reasoning: Decisive for our data policy and easy to miss. SAAMI states the characteristics apply equally to reloaded ammunition, so using them is fine; what SAAMI withholds is PROPELLANT AND PRIMER GUIDANCE. This is why our reload-side data comes from manufacturers and never from SAAMI, and why we could not close the load-data gap by buying the standards.

short_name: SAAMI new and revised cartridge drawings
governs: Forbids publishing a newly accepted SAAMI design as though it were already a published standard
operative_text: These drawings will be incorporated during the next revision of the relevant SAAMI Standard.
reasoning: A free and genuinely useful source, with a status trap. A cartridge drawing listed here is ACCEPTED DESIGN, not yet incorporated into a published Z299 revision, and the page also carries pending REVISIONS to existing drawings. A dimensional correction not yet folded into the standard is exactly the kind of thing that would silently invalidate a cartridge figure we already hold, so any figure taken from here is recorded with its own provenance and re-checked at the next revision.

short_name: Competitor does not vet product data
governs: Forbids treating a competitor's aggregated product or retailer listing as verified data
operative_text: AmmoSeek.com does not vet or endorse any retailer listed on this site. Also, retailers' web sites can change at any time. This could have a negative effect on AmmoSeek's ability to obtain accurate (or any) information. AmmoSeek, LLC is not responsible for inaccurate product information displayed.
reasoning: Recorded as an INTERNAL rule about method, not a legal constraint, and it is the reason the competitor_coverage dataset holds observations rather than copied records. Their own disclaimer says the data is unvetted, so treating their 1.2 million products as a source would import their accuracy problem wholesale. We use them as a shopping list of CALIBERS AND RETAILERS TO RESEARCH, then source the verifiable data ourselves from manufacturers and standards bodies.
